Sub-assistente 2027 Luogo di lavoro San Gallo
• I tuoi compiti e prospettive Per completare l'anno pratico presso HOCH Health Ostschweiz, ti offriamo posti di sub-assistente come sub-assistente nelle aree specialistiche seguenti. Alcune delle nostre cliniche offrono anche stage prima dell'anno pratico sotto forma di stage: Dipartimento Periodo disponibile Dipartimento di Medicina Interna (non offrono stage) Le candidature per il Dipartimento di Medicina Interna San Gallo vengono accettate tramite il seguente link. Sub-assistant 2027 Place of work St. Gallen
• Your tasks and perspectives To complete the practical year at HOCH Health Ostschweiz, we offer you sub-assistant positions as a sub-assistant in the specialist areas below. Some of our clinics also offer internships before the practical year in the form of internships: Department Available period Department of Internal Medicine (do not offer internships) Applications for the Department of Internal Medicine St.Gallen are accepted via the following link. Department of Surgery Mid-October to mid-November Department of Orthopedics and Traumatology (Does not offer internships) April (1 month) June (1 month) October (1 month) Department of Thoracic Surgery occupied Department of Dermatology, Venereology and Allergology (Does not offer internships) occupied (Minimum duration: two months) (Start only possible on the first of the month) Department of Neurology October (1 month) (Minimum duration: two months) Clinic for Neurosurgery Specialty: Cranial January to February (start only possible on the first of the month) Clinic for Neurosurgery Specialty Spinal staffed (start only possible on the first of the month) Clinic for Radiation Oncology January to February July to August October to December Clinic for Radiology and Nuclear Medicine (does not offer internships) July to August (start only possible on the first of the month) Clinic for Plastic Surgery and Hand Surgery (does not offer internships) occupied (Start only on the first of the month and only possible for entire months) Clinic for Urology (does not offer internships) staffed (minimum duration: two months) (Planning begins in this department 12 months. before the start of employment) Clinic for anesthesiology, rescue and pain medicine (does not offer internships) occupied (duration of employment: two months) (start only possible on the first of the month) ENT clinic June (1 month) November to December Eye clinic February (1 month) <td style="text-align:center;w

Sous-assistant 2027 Lieu de travail Saint-Gall
• Vos tâches et perspectives Pour terminer l'année pratique à HOCH Health Ostschweiz, nous vous proposons des postes de sous-assistant en tant que sous-assistant dans les domaines de spécialisation ci-dessous. Certaines de nos cliniques proposent également des stages avant l'année pratique sous forme de stages : Département Période disponible Département de médecine interne (ne proposent pas de stages) Les candidatures pour le Département de médecine interne de Saint-Gall sont acceptées via le lien suivant.
